title: Enable email verification and email provider
description: Activate Better Auth emailVerification, integrate SMTP provider, gate login on verified email
completion: Activated Better Auth emailVerification (conditional on EMAIL_API_URL/EMAIL_API_KEY being configured): requireEmailVerification, sendVerificationEmail, sendResetPassword callbacks using existing sendEmail integration.
